1. Purpose & Statutory Alignment

This policy establishes governance controls for processing, retention, and security of personal and enterprise data in compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023, IT Act 2000 (Section 43A), and CERT-In directives.

2. Scope & Applicability

Applies uniformly to all employees, consultants, contractors, and authorized third-party processors across the Company ({{Applicability}}).

3. Core Privacy & Security Obligations
  • Notice & Lawful Purpose: Process personal data only for documented purposes with verifiable consent.
  • Access Control: Role-based access (RBAC) and MFA must protect all PII, financial, and HR datasets.
  • Data Handling: Exporting employee or customer records to unapproved storage is prohibited.

# Python Backend Integration with WeasyPrint (document-editor)
from weasyprint import HTML
import json
import re

with open('document-editor__privacy-policy-data-protection.json', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    template_pkg = json.load(f)

def render_document(record_data):
    html = template_pkg['template']['html']
    for key, val in record_data.items():
        pattern = re.compile(rf'\{{\{{\s*{re.escape(key)}\s*\}}\}}')
        html = pattern.sub(str(val or ''), html)
    
    # Generate high-fidelity 1:1 vector PDF (honors @page 210mm x 297mm)
    pdf_bytes = HTML(string=html).write_pdf()
    return pdf_bytes
